name: interview-guide-designer
description: Designs interview guides that open people up, part of the Design Thinking Pack by 90n. Use this whenever the user says "run interview-guide-designer", "write an interview guide", "what should we ask users", "prep my discovery interviews", "help me with questions for customer calls", or interviews are scheduled and the question list is a blank page.
